findings.desc: quality-regression: packages/main/src/tasks/proof-admissibility-registry-smoke.ts:116 executes managed-review-evidence-smoke as a mutation child, but the advertised aggregate suite is nondeterministic. A fresh `node packages/main/dist/tasks/managed-cross-provider-suite-smoke.js` run failed because the child reached packages/main/src/tasks/managed-review-evidence-smoke.ts:1015 with `provider proposal capability or agent identity is missing or mismatched` instead of the expected importer-mutation assertion; the standalone smoke and immediate aggregate rerun passed. This order/timing-dependent failure makes CHK-007's aggregate PASS unreliable and can intermittently reject unchanged code.

readManifest.scanEscalationReason: Story-level review spans 139 changed files, so changed paths were filename-triaged and the failing aggregate, mutation, managed-review transport, receipt, process-admission, and lifecycle boundaries were inspected in depth.
